Overview

Curios is a flexible and expandable accessory/equipment API for users and developers. The purpose is to provide functionality for developers to add extra accessory/equipment slots in a convenient and compatible manner, as well as to give users the ability to configure these slots to their preferences. By default, Curios does not add any content except for an inventory GUI. There are no slots and only two items, the latter only being available through the Creative menu and primarily serving as examples for developers to use when coding their own integration.

 Features
 Expandable equipment slots through a central library. New equipment slots can be made and managed easily through an identifier registry. Sable
Sable is a library mod that adds sub-levels to Minecraft. Sub-levels are moving regions of blocks, block-entities, and entities that remain interactive while assembled. Sable contains a physics pipeline (based on the Rapier physics engine written in Rust) that allows sub-levels to move with physics and react to changes in the world. 

Sable does not add any content to the survival game, or any manner of constructing sub-levels in survival. 

Use /sable to assemble, modify, and query sub-levels.

 ⚠️ Compatibility Warning
Sable is an incredibly intrusive mod. It makes extensive use of mixins, and is prone to many compatibility issues with other mods.

swingthrough:
Allows targeting living entities through transparent blocks. 
Requires Connector on neoforge. 
 

---

This mod discards the block crosshair target to allow an entity to be targeted instead, when:

- The block has empty collision
- The entity is living and attackable
- You're not directly riding the entity
- The entity is within reach (exact interaction range in 1.21)

Thanks to this implementation, the block outline will also disappear while you're targeting the entity.

 Technical Notes

This mod is comprised of a single mixin with about 4 lines of meaningful code:

- 2 lines to use the full entity targeting range if the block meets the conditions
- 2 lines to discard the block target if the full range was used and the entity meets the conditions

It performs no additional raycasts or radius searches.

 Afterword

About Dimensional Dungeons

Dimensional Dungeons adds limitless procedurally generated dungeons to Minecraft! These dungeons are all placed in a single, separate dimension which can be accessed from a portal anywhere on the Overworld. (Such as in your base!) This makes the dungeons themselves renewable and it provides challenging, replayable content.

The dungeon dimension limits building and block breaking. This allows for an adventure mode-like experience on a survival server. For example, I can use pistons in my traps without giving the player free pistons. Obstacle courses can't be bridged over. Combat can't be trivialized by building fences around mobs. And light and darkness matter when you can't place torches!

The mod adds a customizable HUD that displays your current pitch during elytra flight, along with an indicator for the optimal angle.

quickcraft:
Quickcraft is a very simple Fabric client-side mod, that adds one thing: the ability to craft recipes from the recipe book, without having to move your mouse to the crafting table output, to grab the items.

The mod activates if you're holding down ctrl while clicking a recipe. This works both for single items and stacks of items, if you hold ctrl and shift at the same time.

The items will get crafted and quick-moved to your inventory. This means that, if you use this mod, it would also be much easier to use an autoclicker to craft things really fast!

If your inventory is full, while auto-crafting using this mod, you'll automatically drop the items in your selected hotbar slot, before auto-crafting. You can also force the mod to drop these items, even if your inventory is not full, by pressing alt at the same time.

 Want to check out more mods from me? Take a look at NotifMod!

maxhealthfix:
Max Health Fix

For a long time, vanilla Minecraft has had this issue of whenever a player joins a world (both for singleplayer and dedicated servers), or when they respawn, if their health is over the vanilla default (which is 20), then regardless of their actual maximum health, their health will be set back to 20, and then only clamped to their max health. It has been acknowledged by Minecraft ever since 2013, but never fixed (MC-17876)

Other mods have already worked towards tackling down this issue. However, none are updated to the game versions that I wanted. Thus, I took upon myself to make it again.

Additionally, other mods that do tackle this issue do it with needless clutter or pointless dependencies for how little really is needed.
Why would you need two extra libraries for this simple change? This mod does it in the upmost vanilla-friendly way, and works just fine on its own.

About
A server-side Fabric mod that adds "teleport ask" commands to Minecraft.

This TPA system adds TP requests, and the ability to accept or deny these requests.

Requests expire after 60 seconds if not accepted or denied.

Accepting a request will instantly teleport the requesting player to your world with your exact position and rotation.

Denying a request will instantly expire it.

Players can control which players they can automatically approve requests for using the /tpautoaccept commands.

Automatic request approval is controlled by the simpletpa:allow instant tpa accepting gamerule, which is enabled by default.

 Commands
 /tprequest - Sends a TP request to the player with a given name .

 /tpaccept - Accepts a TP request from a given player.

 /tpaccept - Accepts a TP request if one and ONLY one is pending.

 /tpdeny - Denies a TP request from a given player.

 /tpdeny - Denie

Normally PatPat syncs between players only if:
- the server itself runs the PatPat mod (Fabric server), or
- the server runs the PatPat Plugin (Bukkit/Spigot/Paper), or
- players have ProxLib + a voice chat mod with proximity packet support

2. The addon intercepts that event and sends it to the relay server over WebSocket

inv-tweaker:
An inventory sorting mod trying to be a homage to the old original "Inventory Tweaks" mod.

The difference to some of the other sorting mods, this one does not only sort alphabetically, but also has the ability to sort in horizontal and vertical groups, making chests etc. look less cluttered and more tidy. This is what Inventory Tweaks did in the past and i haven't found a modern and updated sorting mod, that did exactly that, only alphabetical sorting.

Another feature is the automatic refilling of the hotbar. laminar-engine:
Laminar Engine

 
 
 -orange.svg)
 

 Asynchronous iGPU Co-Processing for Minecraft AI, Acoustics, and Line-of-Sight. 

Laminar is an optimization suite designed to interface the CPU with the built-in integrated graphics processor (Intel HD/UHD Graphics, AMD Radeon Graphics) using explicit OpenCL 1.2/1.1 pipelines.

By offloading computationally intensive CPU tasks, Laminar assists in maintaining server tick rates (TPS) while reducing CPU utilization on the rendering and main logic threads.

 ⚠️ Note: Laminar doesn't increase the maximum FPS you can achieve. It simply improves stability and the ability to handle multiple mobs and sounds simultaneously without lag or significant FPS drops using parallel processing on the iGPU.

---
 Important : The issue with the dedicated server has been fixed without having to separate it into 2 editions(Standart and Server Edition) in version 1.3.1+
--

Two changes/fixes have been made to this module: 
1. no longer overly expensive, level penalties now accrue normally, even over level 40
2. high level enchantments are no longer downgraded when merged on the anvil (since the vanilla checked the level of an enchantment and downgraded it to the max level when it exceeded the max level, this led to the problem that if there was a high level enchantment it would be downgraded as soon as it did something on the anvil)

 Ask & Answer 
- Q: There is already a module with similar functionality, why do you need to write another one?
- A: The author of NoExpensive has no intention of fixing the bug in version 1.20.1 (when merging, lower level enchantments will overwrite higher level enchantments, e.g. [Sharpness 3] + [Sharpness 2 Durability 2] outputs Sharpness 2 Durability 2), and there is no substitute for fixing the high level downgrade problem

Daily Meal

A hunger rework that aims to brings food away from the field and back at home.

Eating and being at full hunger no longer brings any immediate advantage. Instead, the food bar is consumed when sleeping, in exchange for day-long bonuses.

This mod was balanced around a single-player experience. In multiplayer, players who don't participate in skipping the nigh may end up severly disadvantaged. Other mods that allow players to lay in bed during the day should alleviate this issue.

 Mechanics
 Sleeping
All food-related bonuses are cashed-out after sleeping long enough to skip the night. This will work even if night-skips are disabled, or not enough player are sleeping.
Sleeping requires at least 3 food pips (same as for sprinting), but may consume a different amount.

Sleeping will immediately heal you back to full.

Sleeping with a full hunger bar will grant you Regeneration I

craftmine-dailies:
Craftmine Dailies

Every good rogue-like needs dailiy runs (dailies).

 Gameplay

You only have one randomly generated mine per day, which is the same for everyone.

Run starts with a set of forced world ingredients, unlocked world ingredients, (sometimes) a set of forced player unlocks, and a bit of XP.

Collect as many levels in your INVENTORY (XP orbs/Kills DO NOT count!) and go to the mine exit within 30 MINUTES .

 Good to know: 
- If you die or if timer runs out your XP is divided by two .
- World Effects with multipliers count only if you exit the mine .
- Once you enter the mine, you can not leave the world (or your progress will not be saved).

I've recently played minecraft with the Enchancement mod and fell in love with the ability to have tools that never break!

smp-kit-utils:
SMP Utils

A simple combat HUD for SMP PvP. It shows you stuff you already have access to, like how many totems you've got left, who just popped one, and how far away the thing you're hitting is. The point is to keep your eyes on the fight instead of checking your hotbar every two seconds.

It doesn't touch your inputs, your reach or your hitboxes. It just reads what's already there and puts it on screen.

Made with the MCTiers / PvPTiers SMP kit in mind (netherite, totems, gapples) but it works fine for normal survival PvP too.

 Is this a cheat? No

Putting this near the top because people always ask. SMP Utils only shows info your normal client already knows or already gets sent. There's no:

- autocrystal, auto totem, auto anchor or auto pearl
- reach extender, hitbox expander, killaura, aimbot or triggerbot

subsens:
SubSens

 SubSens is a simple and lightweight mod that allows even lower sensitivity in Minecraft.

It is especially useful when you want to have the exact same sensitivity across different games , but you play at high DPI with low in-game sensitivity .

 Features

- Allows sensitivity slider go down to roughly -67% 
- Stores precise number directly in options.txt 
- Supports negative mouseSensitivity values
- No separate menus or config files
- No dependencies

 How it works

By default, your mouse sensitivity is somewhere between 0.0 and 1.0 . However, the game's zero is not the actual zero .

Equipment Weight

This mod adds a weight system for equipment.

This mod is an API for mod and data pack authors. It does nothing on its own.

 Implementation

The ratio of the two new entity attributes generic.equipment weight and generic.max equipment weight is compared to a configurable list of values. When the ratio is equal or greater than one of the values the corresponding status effect is applied. Only one status effect will be applied.

The default attribute values are:
- 0.0 for generic.equipment weight 
- 10.0 for generic.max equipment weight 

 Configuration

The server config contains a map of float values to strings. The strings should be valid identifiers for status effects. Invalid strings are ignored.

 Example

 "weight effects": {
 "0.2": "minecraft:strength",
 "0.5": "minecraft:haste",
 "0.4": "minecraft:regeneration",
 "1.0": "minecraft:glowing"
 }

no-hiding:
No Hiding
This mod turns Minecraft's world incredibly hostile. Every monster will always chase you, even if they cannot see you. This means that you can't take a nice evening stroll in the forest anymore without getting ambushed by dozens of monsters trying to kill you, whether it's zombies, skeletons, creepers or even endermen!

And don't think you are safe in your own base either... Creepers don't take it kindly to be left outside. If they can't reach you, they WILL try to just bomb their way through to you!

 Technical info
- Other 1.19. versions of Minecraft MIGHT work with this mod but are not officially supported.
- This mod might have a moderate performance impact on the game depending on your hardware specs.
- All monsters in a range of 256 blocks will immediately turn aggressive towards you.
- Multiplayer has not been tested and will probably never be officially supported.

 Key Features
 1.0.2
- Fixed scenario where players were unable to click through waxed item frames when crouching with an axe in hand
 1.0.1
- Fixes crash on launch due to extra quotation mark in description

- Initial Release

 Usage
1. Apply Honeycomb directly to item frame (with an item in it) to wax it
2. Right-clicking on (using) a waxed item frame will interact with the block behind the item frame
3. Using an axe on a waxed item frame will remove the wax and return the item frame to normal

Fake Gamemode is a client-side Fabric mod that simulates Creative Mode and administrator commands without requiring actual server permissions. When using commands such as /gamemode creative, the mod changes the client interface to look like Creative Mode by hiding health and hunger bars.  Game-specific APIs
- Conversions and extensions for blocks, fluids and their states

Prism Optimized

A performance-focused modpack for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21, designed to improve FPS, reduce stuttering, and make gameplay feel smoother.

Prism brings together well-known and lesser-known optimization mods that target areas such as rendering, memory use, startup time, and chunk loading. Performance results vary depending on your hardware, settings, and world.

 Performance-focused

Every included mod is selected to support client performance and stability. Prism does not add new gameplay content or extra visual features, keeping the pack focused and lightweight.

 A foundation for your own pack

Use Prism on its own or as a starting point for a custom setup. You can add compatible mods to tailor the experience to your needs. Always check that added mods support your Minecraft version and mod loader.

 Compatibility

The current release is for Minecraft Java Edition 1.

stringdupback:
StringDup Back

 Description:
This plugin brings back a forgotten classic glitch: string duplication using the tripwire system !

 How It Works:

- When a player tries to break a tripwire string with shears , it does not break immediately .
- Instead, the string's state is toggled between armed and disarmed .
- If the string is disarmed , it can now be broken normally by the player.
- When a disarmed string is broken , it drops string while preserving the redstone logic , effectively restoring the original duplication glitch.

 

You have also the /stringtoggle command to toggle every string dupper (when disabled, string still dont break, they just don't drop) and /stringamount to set the amount of string dropped.

This datapack was created because running Cobblemon: Mega Showdown on a multiplayer server usually requires every player to find extremely rare structures which can be quite tedious and make battles feel unfair on those who do not have said items.

This datapack takes the concept of duplicating armour trims in vanilla minecraft, and extends that functionality to these battle gimmick items via custom crafting recipes.
(It also allows uncrafting certain items into their core component, for example a mega bracelet can be crafted back into a keystone)

The idea is that, once one player finds one of these rare items, they can share it with others to duplicate, the same way players often do with armour trims or netherite upgrades.

Overview
 
The British Rail Class 158 Sprinter is a diesel multiple unit train built between 1989 and 1992 by British Rail Engineering Limited (BREL) in Derby, UK. Designed for regional passenger services, the Class 158 offered improved speed, comfort, and noise insulation compared to older rolling stock. It has a maximum speed of 90 mph (145 km/h) and continues to operate across many parts of the UK rail network.

This resource pack adds the BR Class 158 into Minecraft using the Minecraft Transit Railway mod. The original model was made by cw 315 for Transport Fever 2 and was ported to Minecraft by Vitor2005 in 2025. It is compatible with both MTR3 and MTR4.

Included Liveries
This resource pack features the following operator liveries:

- East Midlands Trains
- Northern by Arriva
- ScotRail
- Transport for Wales
- Great Western Railway (GWR)

 Disclaimer
This resource pack is not assoc

pvpshark:
材质包功能介绍

本材质包根据 PVP 和起床战争 的需求制作， 由 B 站 up 主：小鲨鱼工作室 制作 ，主打 简约和实用 。v1.3 重做了整套装备与音效； v1.3.1 把整套界面统一成「蓝色渐变线框 + 内部透明」 。

 武器与装备 
- 全套 深蓝钻石系 ：剑、斧、镐、铲、锄、长矛，色阶统一取自钻石剑
- 下界合金 ：深色底 + 刃上三档金粒（深金 / 中金 / 亮金，集中在轮廓）
- 木、石、铁、金、铜各材质武器； 长矛 支持 7 种材质，长度与造型同原版
- 全套盔甲 ：物品栏图标与 穿在身上 的贴图一并重做（钻石深蓝、其余材质提亮提鲜）
- 拉弓时手中的箭、药水箭、副手物品图标均已修复补全

 动态物品与粒子 
- 末影珍珠 ：动态旋转，1.21 版本另加一层发光光晕
- 风弹 / 火焰弹 ：环绕旋转的动态效果
- 暴击、附魔命中粒子改为蓝色光环
- 鱼竿落水为青色水花粒子

 界面 GUI（v1.3.1 全面重做） 
- 全线框化 ：按钮、输入框 / 搜索栏、滑条、勾选框、标签页、槽位框统一为 蓝色渐变描边 + 透明内核 ；悬停更亮、禁用为暗蓝，三种状态一眼可辨
- 容器面板 ：工作台、熔炉、高炉、烟熏炉、切石机、砂轮、织布机、制图台、锻造台、合成器、村民交易 全部同款透明线框 ；背包格子区与原版配色完全一致，并 补齐了此前缺失的容器 （1.21 补 9 张、1.20 补 11 张）
- 全新快捷栏 ：蓝色圆角格子 + 按键字母 + 选中格上方的小鲨鱼 
- 副手格 与快捷栏同款外观，左右对称
- 创造模式 ：物品栏标签页改为 细线蓝色边框 （选中时向外凸出）；修正滚动条尺寸错误导致的贯穿长线
- 配方书 ：面板与控件重做，「不可合成」格子的红框改为蓝色（ 可合成亮蓝 / 不可合成暗蓝 ）；未选中按钮透明底、打开状态蓝色填充；修掉标签页断开的长线
- 村民交易界面 ：修正贴图尺寸错误导致的整体错位
- 知识之书 ：蓝色渐变轮廓 + 保留原版书页亮带
- 经验球 / 经验条 ：经验球换成封面配色的小鲨鱼（灰身 + 绿围巾，16 帧）；经验条改蓝色渐变

Seamless Glowing Ores is a resource pack that makes ores glow in the dark. An optional outline joins
touching ore of the same type into one shape, even when the blocks sit in different kinds of stone,
and an optional glint moves across the ore every few seconds.

 

 One file, eight looks

The pack is one file, and the look is chosen in game with
 Respackopts ,
which is optional:

 Setting Choices 
 --- ---

替换木板、羊毛、荧石、黏土和金块五种乐器的音色为钢琴，荧石右击6下的音高为中央C，音高从左往右升高，每个乐器采样间距一个八度。如两个右击次数都为12的音符盒，垫块分别是荧石和黏土，那么黏土被激活时发出的声音比荧石高一个八度。
Replace the timbres of five instruments—wood planks, wool, glowstone, clay, and gold blocks—with piano. The pitch of glowstone after six right-clicks is middle C. The pitch increases from left to right, and the sampling interval between each instrument is one octave.For example, if two note blocks both have 12 right-clicks, and the blocks beneath them are glowstone and clay respectively, then the sound produced by the clay when activated is one octave higher than that of the glowstone.
essential-cohesion:
The concept behind this idea is elegantly straightforward. Personally, I experienced a sense of frustration upon launching the game with the Essential mod installed, only to be confronted by the stark contrast between its sleek interface and the somewhat outdated appearance of Minecraft's vanilla UI .
Moreover, the starkness of the light contrast was a minor annoyance to me.

 In response, a thought occurred to me-why not address this issue?

Consequently, this Resource pack takes on the task of harmonizing these two distinct themes. By imbuing the well-known, classic GUI with Essential's modern aesthetics, the result is a seamless integration that brings together the best of both worlds. The interface gains a refined smoothness , sporting a darker and more visually pleasing theme. This synthesis creates a sense of unity between the original Minecraft atmosphere and the innovative appeal

Token-grabbing is one of the biggest threats facing Minecraft players today. With Discord2FA, every login is verified through Discord — meaning even if someone steals a player's Minecraft credentials, they still can't get in without access to their Discord account.
Beyond security, Discord2FA makes a great verification gate: players must link and verify through Discord before they can interact with your server, significantly reducing alt accounts and anonymous trolling.
